scripts.setup: pnpm run setup:certs && pnpm install && cd backend && uv sync
scripts.setup:certs: mkdir -p certs && cd certs && mkcert -install && mkcert "yupiboard.localhost" "*.yupiboard.localhost"
scripts.migrate: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run fastapi dev app/main.py --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
scripts.generate:api: cd backend && uv run python -m app.scripts.export_openapi -o ../frontend/openapi/openapi.json && cd .. && pnpm --filter frontend api:generate
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:frontend && pnpm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ty check app
scripts.format: pnpm run format:frontend && pnpm run format:backend
scripts.format:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff format .
